claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall source repository was inspected from a pinned commit.
claims.required_evidence: Git commit hash from public repository.
claims.reproduction_command: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Instinctes/nightfall.git && git -C nightfall rev-parse HEAD
claims.limitation: Only the checked public GitHub source snapshot is covered.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has a public security policy file.
claims.limitation: Presence of SECURITY.md does not prove security.
Contribution rules do not prove maintainer review quality.
Workflow presence does not prove all checks are passing at every commit.
Release workflow presence does not prove binary reproducibility or signature validity.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has internal audit or review documents in docs/.
claims.limitation: Internal review documents are not external audits.

claims.required_evidence: Named independent audit report with scope, date, commit, findings and auditor identity.
claims.reproduction_command: grep -RInE 'Internal|not independent|not an outside audit|not an audit' SECURITY.md docs/
claims.limitation: This WVP v0.1 check does not search the full internet or validate external auditor identities.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has no premine, treasury, mint authority, freeze capability or admin key.
claims.required_evidence: Full code review of consensus, genesis, emission, wallet and release history.
claims.reproduction_command: grep -RInE 'admin key|mint authority|freeze capability|premine|treasury|ecosystem fund' README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md FAIR_LAUNCH.md docs crates
claims.limitation: Keyword scanning can find leads but cannot prove absence of backdoors.
Document presence does not prove historical fairness.

claims.atomic_claim: This WVP report proves Nightfall is secure.
claims.observed_evidence: WVP v0.1 is a claim/evidence reality check only.
claims.limitation: Security requires independent audit, adversarial testing, formal review where applicable and time under mainnet conditions.
